claim_ceiling: These 35 theorems are kernel-checked structure theory for the Erdos-Turan conjecture (Erdos Problem 28): a semantic binding to the upstream formalisation, the elementary floor limsup r_A >= 2, a two-sided Theta(sqrt N) pin on any counterexample, and two KILL theorems showing the parity route and the parity-plus-second-moment route cannot exceed 2. They do NOT resolve Erdos 28, and the floor is FAR BELOW the published record (Borwein-Choi-Chu 2006, >= 8, CITED and UNPROVED here). The banked artifact is the machine-checked formalisation and the receipts, NOT a novel theorem.
